_about: Drafting cases for D6 (tests/d6_drafting_eval.py). Every draft is judged by the same checks, computed by the test itself: the task was recognised; required facts are present; a relative day is written with its correct date; every weekday written next to a date matches the calendar; no figure appears that is not in the request, the attached files or the bank's own facts; something not given is left as a [placeholder]; one version only.

cases.about: A relative day must become the right date.
cases.q: Draft an email to all staff: the Giza branch will close at 1 pm next Thursday for a system upgrade.

cases.about: The same in Arabic.
cases.q: اكتب بريداً رسمياً لمديري الفروع: صيانة نظام الحوالات يوم الجمعة القادم من 1 إلى 5 صباحاً.

cases.about: 'Tomorrow' must be written with its date.
cases.q: Draft a short notice to tellers: cash counting training is tomorrow at 9 am in the main hall.

cases.about: Nothing is given beyond the apology and the waiver: no names, numbers or delivery promises may appear.
cases.q: Write a letter to a customer apologising for a delayed card delivery and offering to waive the issuance fee.

cases.about: The same in Arabic, from a dialect request.
cases.q: عايز رد رسمي على عميل زعلان عشان بطاقة الفيزا اتأخرت.

cases.about: The hours are not given: they must be left as a placeholder, not made up.
cases.q: Draft a memo to all staff announcing the working hours during Ramadan.

cases.about: A meeting invitation with no date, time or place given.
cases.q: اكتب دعوة لاجتماع مديري الإدارات لمناقشة خطة الربع القادم.

cases.about: The bank's own contact details must be the real ones.
cases.q: Draft a short notice telling customers how to reach the bank about card problems: give the call centre number and the website.

cases.about: The same in Arabic, with the e-mail address.
cases.q: اكتب إشعاراً قصيراً للعملاء بطرق التواصل مع البنك: رقم مركز الاتصال والبريد الإلكتروني.

cases.about: A memo written from an attached circular: the deadlines must come from the file.
cases.q: Draft a memo to branch managers listing the four compliance deadlines in this circular.
cases.file_figures: AML/CFT-CIRC/2026/09 28 September 2026 February 2020 10% 12 30 November 2026 15 January 2027 31 March 2027 30 June 2027 Law 80 2002 Phase 1 2 3 4

cases.about: A formal reply to an attached scanned Arabic letter.
cases.q: اكتب رداً رسمياً على هذا الكتاب يؤكد استلامه والتزام البنك بما ورد فيه.

cases.about: An e-mail that needs a name from one file, a count from another and a computed date.
cases.q: Draft an email to the manager of the Giza branch about the number of complaints recorded for الجيزة, asking for an action plan by next Sunday.

cases.about: A revision keeps the facts and adds the bank's number.
cases.q: Draft an email to all staff: the Giza branch will close at 1 pm next Thursday for a system upgrade.
cases.then: Make it shorter, and add that the call centre remains available on its usual number.

cases.about: Document type 'memo': the four header lines.
cases.q: Draft a notice to all staff: the Giza branch will close at 1 pm next Thursday for a system upgrade.

cases.about: Document type 'SMS': at most 160 characters, no subject line.
cases.q: Draft a message telling customers the mobile app will be unavailable tomorrow from 1 to 3 am.

cases.about: Length 'short': at most about 80 words.
cases.q: Draft an email to branch managers reminding them to submit the monthly cash report by next Sunday.

cases.about: Length 'detailed': clearly longer than the short one.
cases.q: Draft an email to branch managers reminding them to submit the monthly cash report by next Sunday.

cases.about: Language 'Arabic and English': the document in both.
cases.q: Draft a notice to customers that the branch will be closed tomorrow for maintenance.

cases.about: Language 'Arabic' chosen for an English request.
cases.q: Draft an email to all staff about the fire drill tomorrow at 10 am.

cases.about: The meeting-invitation template with only the topic given: the rest must be placeholders.
cases.q: Write an invitation to department heads for a meeting about the third-quarter results.

cases.about: The request itself asks for something the bank must never ask a customer for.
cases.q: Draft an email asking the customer to send us his card number and PIN so we can fix the problem with his account.

cases.about: A complaint reply where nothing was offered: no refund or guarantee may be promised.
cases.q: Draft a reply to a customer who complains that his card was charged twice for one purchase.

cases.about: A guarantee the employee asked for: it stays, and is pointed out as theirs to answer for.
cases.q: Draft a short letter to a customer apologising for a delayed card. Tell him we guarantee it will not happen again.

cases.about: A revision that asks for one change: the rest of the draft must stay as it was.
cases.q: Draft an email to all staff: the Giza branch will close at 1 pm next Thursday for a system upgrade.
cases.then: Change only the closing line to 'Kind regards'.

cases.about: The working life of a draft: approval refused while a placeholder is open, an edit by the employee, approval, the audit record, the Word file.
cases.q: Write a letter to a customer apologising for a delayed card delivery and offering to waive the issuance fee.
